stories.title: AEW Grand Slam Mexico 2026
stories.tldr: AEW held Grand Slam Mexico 2026 at the legendary Arena Mexico, featuring eight matches over approximately 2 hours and 53 minutes. Adam Copeland achieved a major bucket-list goal by competing in Arena Mexico for the first time in 18 years, while Will Ospreay defeated Mark Davis in a 17-minute Street Fight and Adam Page's team won the AEW World Trios Championship.

stories.title: Buddy Matthews AEW Return Cleared
stories.tldr: Buddy Matthews has been medically cleared to return to in-ring competition after suffering a serious ankle injury at AEW Grand Slam: Australia in February 2025. The AEW star announced his clearance via Instagram video on August 6, 2026, after nearly 18 months of recovery including surgery, rehabilitation, and physical therapy. Matthews expressed his readiness to return with the statement "I'm cleared, and you should be scared," though no specific return date has been announced yet.

stories.title: AEW Collision Tag Team Match
stories.tldr: Hikaru Shida and Persephone will team up against Maya World and Hyan on this Saturday's AEW Collision in Colorado Springs. The tag team match stems from Shida's recent interference helping Persephone defeat Kris Statlander at Grand Slam Mexico, setting up a clash between the two teams heading toward All In 2026 at Wembley Stadium in three weeks.

stories.title: AEW Commentators
stories.tldr: AEW's commentary team continues to evolve with several potential new voices that could enhance their programming across Dynamite, Collision, and pay-per-views. The article examines six candidates including NJPW's Walker Stewart, WWE veterans Mick Foley and Mauro Ranallo, independent standout Veda Scott, and wrestlers Jeff Jarrett and others who could transition into commentary roles. These additions could provide fresh perspectives while addressing gaps like the lack of female commentators on flagship wrestling shows.

stories.title: Adam Copeland Arena Mexico Debut
stories.tldr: Following his Arena Mexico debut loss, Adam Copeland issued an emotional statement reflecting on finally performing in the legendary venue after 34 years, calling it a bucket list item he'll "take to the grave." Copeland and Christian Cage will next defend their AEW World Tag Team Championships against The Young Bucks at All In: London later this month.

stories.title: Jacques Rougeau and AEW
stories.tldr: A wrestling columnist has defended Jacques Rougeau's handling of the tribute video, arguing that AEW used excuses rather than honest communication. The column suggests that AEW's concerns about copyright and AI were avoidable issues that could have been resolved if the company had been upfront about its policies beforehand. Meanwhile, WWE has begun releasing Jacques' retirement match, potentially signaling a path toward future recognition from the company.

stories.title: AEW All In: London 2026 Updated Lineup
stories.tldr: AEW has announced several major title matches for All In: London 2026, including Kenny Omega defending the World Championship against Will Ospreay, Willow Nightingale facing Mercedes Moné for the Women's World title, and tag team championship bouts featuring both the World and Women's tag champions. A Men's Casino Gauntlet Match with Andrade El Ídolo confirmed is also on the card, with additional competitors to be announced.

stories.title: Oba Femi Moves to WWE SmackDown After Brock Lesnar Victory
stories.tldr: Oba Femi has been announced for WWE SmackDown on August 21, 2026 in Toronto following his Hell in a Cell victory over Brock Lesnar at SummerSlam. The appearance has sparked speculation about which world champion Femi will pursue with his guaranteed King of the Ring title shot, with both CM Punk (SmackDown) and Roman Reigns (Raw) being potential targets. Punk has already publicly invited Femi to challenge him, while Femi currently works on Raw.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown August 7 Lineup
stories.tldr: WWE has announced a stacked August 7 SmackDown episode featuring Kevin Owens making his first appearance since his SummerSlam return, where he won a fatal four-way match to become the number one contender to CM Punk's Undisputed WWE Championship. The show will also feature a Charlotte Flair vs. Jade Cargill women's singles match and an appearance from interim WWE Women's Champion Chelsea Green, with multiple championship storylines set to advance.

stories.title: Becky Lynch and Finn Bálor Dublin Announcement
stories.tldr: WWE Superstars Becky Lynch and Finn Balor will make a "massive announcement" during a live studio appearance on Newstalk FM's Off The Ball show in Dublin on Friday, August 7 at 7 p.m. local time. While WWE has not officially confirmed the content, widespread speculation suggests the announcement could involve WWE's first-ever premium live event in Ireland, potentially as part of the "Clash" branded international event series.

stories.title: Aleister Black Post-WWE Release New Look
stories.tldr: Aleister Black has entered free agency following his April WWE release and teased his next move with a cryptic video showing off a dramatic new shaved head look while training in martial arts. The video, captioned "I am the death of me," suggests he is physically in top shape and preparing for a new chapter, though his wrestling future remains unclear with potential bridges burned at AEW due to past comments from MJF. Black has also updated his social media to reflect his real name Tom Budgen while listing his indie name Tommy End in his bio.

stories.title: WWE Hawaii Live Event October 2026
stories.tldr: WWE announced its return to Hawaii for the first time in seven years with a live event scheduled for Friday, October 16, 2026, at Blaisdell Arena in Honolulu. The card features Seth Rollins, Liv Morgan, The Usos, Jacob Fatu, Oba Femi, and Sol Ruca, with more stars expected to be announced. WWE will also hold a talent tryout at the venue, and tickets go on sale August 14 with a presale beginning August 12.

stories.title: WWE SummerSlam 2029 Location
stories.tldr: WWE SummerSlam 2029 will be held in Indianapolis, Indiana, according to reports from WrestleVotes Radio on Fightful Select. The location was locked in as part of a premium live event agreement between WWE and Indiana Sports Corporation finalized in June 2024, which also included WrestleMania and Royal Rumble events for the city.

stories.title: Netflix Edits Becky Lynch Content from WWE Raw
stories.tldr: WWE edited out a controversial line from Becky Lynch's August 3 promo segment during the Netflix replay of WWE Raw. Lynch made a remark about Liv Morgan not being the greatest Women's Champion to sleep with Dominik Mysterio, referencing Rhea Ripley. This marks another instance of WWE altering content for the streaming platform, following previous edits to segments featuring Bron Breakker and Brock Lesnar.

stories.title: John Cena WWE Retirement and RVD Tribute
stories.tldr: John Cena concluded his in-ring wrestling career in December 2025 with a final match against Gunther at WWE Saturday Night's Main Event. Rob Van Dam, despite being scheduled to face Cena during the retirement tour, was sidelined by injury but still appeared at the final event and received the loudest crowd reaction of the night. Cena has since paid tribute to fellow retiring legends Brock Lesnar and AJ Styles, both of whom he faced during his farewell tour.

stories.title: Blake Monroe and Love Island
stories.tldr: Blake Monroe, now a WWE SmackDown superstar, revealed she turned down opportunities to appear on Love Island not once but twice during her career. The wrestler explained her decision was based on her discomfort with the show's dating format, particularly the romantic challenges where contestants kiss and interact with multiple people, combined with her belief that contestants prioritize career building over genuine romance.

stories.title: Nattie and TJ Wilson ALS Ice Bucket Challenge
stories.tldr: Natalya and TJ Wilson participated in the ALS Ice Bucket Challenge to support fellow wrestler Rebel, who is battling ALS. They were nominated by Rebel and Beth Phoenix, and in turn nominated Angelo Dawkins, Bayley, and Brodie Lee Jr. AEW will host a charity event called AEW Rebel Heart on September 9 to continue supporting Rebel's fight against the disease.

stories.title: The Undertaker Podcast Renewal and GUNTHER
stories.tldr: The Undertaker has announced he will not renew his contract with WWE's "Six Feet Under" podcast, expressing his disinterest in podcasting by saying he'd "rather go to the dentist." During the same appearance, he discussed GUNTHER as a potential final opponent, while also praising other current WWE talent like Trick Williams and acknowledging his past encounters with Hulk Hogan.

stories.title: Roman Reigns and AAA
stories.tldr: Chelsea Green has expressed interest in bringing the Interim WWE Women's Championship to AAA, mirroring Roman Reigns' upcoming championship defense in Mexico City. Green revealed she already reached out about the possibility and credits her history in Mexican wrestling and the growing WWE-AAA partnership for renewed fan interest in her connection to lucha libre. The crossover marks an expansion of WWE's relationship with the Mexican promotion beyond just Reigns' World Heavyweight Championship defense.

stories.title: WWE 2026 PLE Schedule
stories.tldr: WWE has announced its 2026 premium live event schedule, featuring major events including WWE Sunday Night's Main Event on September 6 in Atlanta and WWE Money in the Bank on October 10 in New Orleans. The company continues to utilize streaming platforms like Peacock and Netflix for viewing options depending on geographic location. Additional PLE events scheduled throughout the year include Royal Rumble, Elimination Chamber, WrestleMania 42, Backlash, Clash in Italy, Night of Champions, and SummerSlam.

stories.title: WWE Money in the Bank 2026 Debuts
stories.tldr: WWE Money in the Bank returns on October 10, 2026, from New Orleans at a new time of year, creating an opportunity for the company to debut six major NXT stars on the main roster. The anticipated debuts include former NXT Champions Tatum Paxley and Kelani Jordan, rising star Izzi Dame, the entire faction The Vanity Project, Lola Vice, and the cornerstone NXT talent Tony D'Angelo, all of whom have established themselves as ready for the next stage of their careers.

stories.title: Dominik Mysterio Marriage and Liv Morgan Storyline
stories.tldr: Dominik Mysterio balances his on-screen romantic relationship with Liv Morgan by maintaining clear communication with his real-life wife Marie, whom he has been with since age 14. Mysterio emphasized that his wife understands professional wrestling is entertainment and he separates his "Dirty Dom" character from his personal life as a caring husband.

stories.title: Jake Roberts Favorite Snake and Opponent
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Jake "The Snake" Roberts recently appeared on The Rival Room Sports Podcast where he discussed his favorite opponent and his favorite snake from his wrestling career. Roberts revealed that while his favorite moment involved his cobra biting "Macho Man" Randy Savage, his favorite opponent to work with was Ricky Steamboat due to their excellent in-ring chemistry. He praised the cobra as his favorite snake, calling it impressive and noting how much fun he had working with it.

stories.title: Booker T Busted Open Radio Wrestling Talk
stories.tldr: Booker T believes that despite WWE Radio's new focus on the Stamford-based company, the station's programming won't exclusively cover WWE. Speaking on his podcast, Booker T expressed confidence that personalities like Bully Ray will maintain their independent commentary and discuss other wrestling promotions, comparing the network's approach to the Wild West with diverse wrestling coverage.

stories.title: Nikki Bella Celibate Viral Story
stories.tldr: Nikki Bella became embarrassed after a throwaway comment she made went viral during her SummerSlam weekend comeback, generating unexpected headlines and text messages. She later admitted she didn't actually know what the word "celibate" meant and Googled it, discovering it referred to choosing no marriage and no sex, which made her earlier nun joke even more awkward in hindsight.

stories.title: Conrad Thompson Roman Reigns and Paul Heyman
stories.tldr: Conrad Thompson has doubled down on his controversial claim that Roman Reigns is the most overrated main-event star in WWE history, arguing that Paul Heyman deserves nearly all the credit for Reigns' transformation into a top star. Thompson pointed to years of crowd rejection during WrestleMania 31-33 and the night after WrestleMania 33 when fans booed Reigns for seven straight minutes, insisting that without Heyman's management and presentation changes, Reigns would never have gained acceptance. Thompson further claimed that no main eventer in WWE history has benefited more from having a manager than Reigns, comparing him unfavorably to legends like Hulk Hogan and Steve Austin who needed no such assistance.

stories.title: Cruz Montana WWE Name Change
stories.tldr: Former AEW star Mike Santana has officially changed his ring name to Cruz Montana upon joining WWE's Tuesday night brand. The name carries deep personal meaning, honoring his late father and incorporating references to the film "Blood In Blood Out," his family's influence, and the personal struggles he has overcome throughout his life.

stories.title: Rhea Ripley Knee Surgery and WWE Women's Championship
stories.tldr: Rhea Ripley has undergone knee surgery to repair a meniscus tear sustained in June, marking the first surgery of her wrestling career. The procedure could significantly impact WWE's plans for an eventual unification match between Ripley and interim Women's Champion Chelsea Green, with reports suggesting Ripley may end up vacating the title entirely depending on her recovery timeline.

stories.title: AJ Styles WWE NXT Role and Avery Jones
stories.tldr: AJ Styles is temporarily filling in as a coach at WWE's Performance Center while Terry Taylor recovers from knee surgery, and he's already making changes to training methods to keep talent engaged. Meanwhile, Nattie Neidhart has publicly praised Avery Jones, AJ's son, after watching him wrestle during SummerSlam week, and suggested AJ could be motivated to come out of retirement for a tag team with his son.

stories.title: Brock Lesnar WWE Retirement Status Uncertain
stories.tldr: WWE had SummerSlam 2026 planned as Lesnar's retirement date all along, according to Dave Meltzer. However, multiple backstage sources now suggest WWE officials don't believe Lesnar is truly done and expect him to appear at WrestleMania 43 in Saudi Arabia, either in a match or headlining the Hall of Fame ceremony, citing one final "payday" as motivation.

stories.title: Nick Aldis WWE In-Ring Future
stories.tldr: WWE backstage sources believe Nick Aldis will wrestle again for the company, though his next match likely won't happen until 2027. Multiple people within WWE view Aldis as equally or more talented than several regular roster members and want to see him receive a significant in-ring run rather than remain a one-off performer.

stories.title: Trick Williams US Championship Loss Surprise
stories.tldr: The decision to have Baron Corbin defeat Trick Williams for the US Championship at SummerSlam came together late in planning, surprising backstage personnel who expected Williams to hold the title longer. Williams is now eyeing a dream match with CM Punk and has assembled a potential WarGames team featuring fellow NXT alumni.

stories.title: Chelsea Green WWE Women's Championship and Character Comparisons
stories.tldr: Triple H compared Green's fan-driven rise to Daniel Bryan and Kofi Kingston's underdog-to-champion journeys, a comparison Green initially hadn't made herself but now deeply appreciates. She's also already requested permission to bring the Women's Championship to AAA in Mexico, citing her history with lucha wrestling and her connection to Mexican fans as motivation for expanding her title reign globally.

stories.title: Baron Corbin US Championship SummerSlam 2026
stories.tldr: WWE made a surprise late creative decision to put the US Championship on Corbin just weeks after Trick Williams debuted his custom white-fur title belt, catching multiple people backstage off guard. Corbin revealed the emotional toll of his entrance and a meaningful full-circle moment with Triple H post-match. Meanwhile, Trick is eyeing potential new directions, including a possible program with CM Punk.

stories.title: Brie Bella SummerSlam Injury Recovery
stories.tldr: Brie Bella confirmed she will not need surgery for her multiple scapula fractures sustained at SummerSlam, instead relying on conservative treatment. She expects to miss three to six months of in-ring action while undergoing X-rays every two weeks, with physical therapy beginning in two weeks. The timing is unfortunate as it comes just after her sister Nikki's return from a broken ankle.

stories.title: Shiloh Hill NXT Injury Update
stories.tldr: Shiloh Hill has received encouraging news regarding his fractured maxilla, with doctors now believing he could return to in-ring competition sooner than initially expected. The rapid reduction in swelling and the specific placement of the fracture have improved his recovery outlook. Hill has not been cleared to compete yet, but the timeline is no longer as grim as suggested in his initial injury announcement.

stories.title: Randy Orton WWE Return After SummerSlam
stories.tldr: Randy Orton is confirmed for the August 7 SmackDown in Philadelphia, his first appearance since attacking Cody Rhodes at SummerSlam. The show will also feature CM Punk, Kevin Owens, and several other matches. WWE creative appears poised to rebuild the Rhodes-Orton feud without the celebrity and outside interference that complicated their WrestleMania program earlier this year.

stories.title: Stephanie Vaquer WWE Return Direction
stories.tldr: WWE's creative direction for Vaquer involves continuing her feud with Liv Morgan and The Judgment Day as originally planned before her injury layoff. With Becky Lynch now also entering the Women's World Championship picture, the company has multiple storyline threads converging in the women's title scene. Reports confirm this multi-competitor angle was the intended opportunity WWE waited for before bringing Vaquer back.

stories.title: Chad Gable WWE Intercontinental Championship
stories.tldr: Chad Gable credited a serious rotator cuff injury as the unexpected catalyst that shaped his entire championship journey, calling the sequence of events "impossibly perfect." With the title now in hand, multiple challengers including Penta, Dominik Mysterio, Ethan Page, Rusev, El Grande Americano, and Bron Breakker are positioned as potential next contenders for his Intercontinental Championship.

stories.title: Royal Rumble 2027 Two-Night Format
stories.tldr: WWE internally discussed making Royal Rumble 2027 a two-night event but currently expects it to remain one night. However, the company has significant interest in eventually transforming Royal Rumble into a multi-night destination event similar to WrestleMania, with 2027 potentially being the final single-night iteration.

stories.title: Lola Vice WWE Main Roster Call-up
stories.tldr: WWE filed a trademark for "Vice City" on the same night Lola Vice departed NXT, signaling her imminent main roster debut. The trademark covers standard WWE performer services including live events, broadcasts, and online content. Vice is expected to join the SmackDown roster, where her boyfriend Damian Priest performs.

stories.title: The Undertaker WWE and AAA Creative Role
stories.tldr: The Undertaker has been actively reshaping the WWE AAA roster through strategic signings and acquisitions since taking over as head of creative. The promotion is targeting underutilized WWE talent like Johnny Gargano, Candice LeRae, and Ilja Dragunov, while also pursuing free agents and prospects from international promotions to strengthen both the men's and women's divisions.

stories.title: Joe Hendry Concert Segment with Danhausen
stories.tldr: Joe Hendry doubled down on his defense of the concert segment during a Cheap Heat podcast appearance, explaining that he and his collaborators always give maximum effort regardless of whether creative risks connect with audiences. He drew parallels to his indie wrestling days, noting that not every segment will land but the commitment to entertaining remains constant.

stories.title: Crowbar Inducted into Indie Wrestling Hall of Fame
stories.tldr: Crowbar, the veteran wrestler who began his career in 1993 as Devon Storm, has been inducted into the 2026 Indie Wrestling Hall of Fame. The announcement was made by Joey Janela during his 20th Anniversary event on August 6. Crowbar's three-decade career spans major promotions including WWE, WCW, ECW, AEW, TNA, NJPW, Ring of Honor and GCW, along with numerous independent circuits, establishing him as one of wrestling's most respected and dependable veterans.

stories.title: Rob Van Dam Fatherhood and Wrestling Observations
stories.tldr: Rob Van Dam recently discussed how becoming a father to twin daughters at age 54 completely shifted his life priorities and made him prioritize his health differently. In separate comments, the WWE Hall of Famer also criticized modern wrestlers for overusing the same high-flying moves repeatedly throughout matches, arguing that this practice diminishes the special nature of signature offense and prevents performers from establishing individual identities.

stories.title: Xia Brookside TNA Knockouts Championship
stories.tldr: Xia Brookside successfully defended her TNA Knockots World Championship against WWE NXT and EVOLVE Superstar Wendy Choo on Thursday's episode of TNA Impact. Brookside retained her title after reversing Choo's Snooze Button finisher into her own Dark Side DDT for the victory. After the match, challenger Elayna Black confronted the champion, setting up a potential future title opportunity.

stories.title: Dijak on JCW Lunacy
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Dijak made a surprise appearance on JCW Lunacy on August 6, 2026, revealing himself as Jasmin St. Claire's handpicked enforcer and stepfather figure for her unborn child. After being mocked over her pregnancy storyline and dissatisfied with Mr. Happy being revealed as the biological father, Jasmin recruited Dijak as personal muscle to command respect. The addition of the imposing former WWE talent has escalated what was already one of wrestling's strangest angles into even more chaotic territory.

stories.title: Paul Walter Hauser PROGRESS Wrestling Return
stories.tldr: Paul Walter Hauser has been confirmed to return to PROGRESS Wrestling for the "When September Ends" Chapter show on September 27th at the Electric Ballroom in Camden, London. The current Proteus Champion will defend his title at the event, marking his first match since WrestleMania weekend in April when he defeated Big Damo, the company's new owner, in a 100,000 Dollar Challenge match. Hauser has not wrestled on the independent scene during his layoff period.

stories.title: WCW Clash of the Champions XXXI Sting Match
stories.tldr: On August 6, 1995, WCW presented Sting and Road Warrior Hawk versus Stud Stable at Clash of the Champions XXXI, a match that received a minus 2-star rating from Dave Meltzer. The match was criticized for poor performances all around, particularly Hawk's worst outing ever, and questionable booking decisions including the misuse of credentialed wrestler Kurasawa in a poorly executed martial arts gimmick.

stories.title: Title Changes August 6
stories.tldr: August 6th has historically been a relatively quiet day for professional wrestling title changes compared to recent weeks, with around 204 notable title changes recorded on this date. Notable champions crowned on August 6th include Tajiri (WWF World Light Heavyweight Title in 2001), La Parka (Mexican National Light Heavyweight Title in 1995), and most recently Lluvia and Tessa Blanchard (CMLL World Women's Tag Team Titles in 2024).

stories.title: Kevin Nash on Wrestling Missing Gritty Feel
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Kevin Nash believes modern professional wrestling has lost the "gritty feel" that made matches look like legitimate fights, citing vintage footage of wrestlers like Tully Blanchard and Sam Houston as examples of a harder-hitting style. During a podcast discussion, co-host Sean Oliver countered that wrestling has simply evolved like other entertainment and sports, comparing it to how fans can passionately support opposing sides in traditional sports without needing heel and babyface dynamics, though Nash maintains the traditional match structure remains important.

stories.title: Money Power Respect and Juwan Thomas
stories.tldr: Money Power Respect issued an ultimatum to Juwan Thomas after he was abandoned during a six-man tag match at EMERGE 98, demanding he accept the group's philosophy that no individual member stands above the collective. While the group acknowledged Thomas's aggressive wrestling ability and suggested he could be valuable to them, Thomas must decide whether to accept their conditions. Meanwhile, Paragon and Christopher Moore will challenge the Dead Presidents for the EMERGE World Tag Team Championship at EMERGE 99 on September 5 in Columbus, Indiana.

stories.title: House Of Glory Announces Full Lineup For HOG High Intensity
stories.tldr: House of Glory has unveiled the complete card for HOG High Intensity taking place Friday, August 7, featuring five championship matches including Charles Mason defending the HOG World Championship against Eddie Kingston, and The Hardys putting their tag titles on the line. The event will be streamed live on YouTube and also includes a Matt Travis Memorial Battle Royal where the winner can claim a title shot of their choosing at any time.

stories.title: Netflix Censors Royce Keys’ Blood from 8/3 WWE RAW Replay
stories.tldr: Netflix has been editing WWE RAW replays to remove content that aired live, including blood from Jacob Fatu's assault on Royce Keys and a controversial Becky Lynch joke about Dominik Mysterio. This censoring is part of a growing trend of changes to WWE's streaming replays that have also included blurred blood, removed gestures, altered crowd chants, and other edits. The practice raises questions about whether live broadcasts and streaming replays should match.

stories.title: Daily Update: NXT Heatwave, AJPW, Marc Mero
stories.tldr: WWE's NXT Heatwave PLE takes place August 30 in Edinburgh, Texas with a card featuring Tony D'Angelo, Kendal Grey, Cruz Montana, Nattie, and Kelani Jordan. Rhea Ripley underwent knee surgery with implications for the Women's title picture, while Marc Mero revealed he may need shoulder replacement surgery. AEW's Tony Khan praised Grand Slam Mexico as one of his favorite AEW events ever, and AJPW announced a memorial for the late Dory Funk Jr.

stories.title: 6 New WWE Signings On SmackDown
stories.tldr: SmackDown is positioned to receive six major roster additions following SummerSlam 2026, headlined by NXT Champion Tony D'Angelo, who recently made history as the brand's first Grand Slam Champion. The potential signings include several accomplished NXT stars such as Kelani Jordan, Nikkita Lyons, Tatum Paxley, Jaida Parker, and Lola Vice, all of whom have established themselves as ready for main roster competition. These additions would significantly strengthen SmackDown's women's division and overall depth following recent returns of Kevin Owens and Randy Orton, plus the arrival of GUNTHER and Undisputed WWE Champion CM Punk.

stories.title: Dark Side of The Ring bonus look: Renegade vs. Arn Anderson | Opinion
stories.tldr: A Dark Side of The Ring episode covered Rick Wilson, the WCW Renegade character who was an Ultimate Warrior clone portrayed by an exotic dancer. The article reviews his WCW Television Title match against Arn Anderson at The Great American Bash in June 1995, where despite Wilson's obvious inexperience in the ring, he managed to defeat Anderson and win the title, though the crowd's lack of reaction revealed their indifference to the character.

stories.title: 7 WWE NXT Stars To Main Event WrestleMania
stories.tldr: WWE is developing seven NXT stars with the potential to headline WrestleMania in the future. The list includes Lola Vice, Kelani Jordan, Zaria, Myles Borne, Tony D'Angelo, and Cruz Montana, all of whom have demonstrated championship-caliber abilities and character work on the developmental brand that could translate to main roster success.

stories.title: Huge Main Event Set For Tonight’s WWE Summer Tour Live Event
stories.tldr: WWE's 2026 Summer Tour continues tonight with a non-televised live event at EagleBank Arena in Fairfax, Virginia, featuring a Triple Threat Match for the Undisputed WWE Championship. Reigning champion CM Punk will defend his title against Cody Rhodes and GUNTHER, fresh off their respective victories at SummerSlam Night 1 this past Saturday.

stories.title: WWE News: Behind-The-Scenes Of Bloodline’s Entrance, Cody Rhodes’ Helmet, Kevin Owens’ Return, Brock Lesnar, More
stories.tldr: WWE held SummerSlam 2026 over the weekend in Minneapolis with major storyline developments including Kevin Owens' surprise return earning him a No. 1 Contendership to CM Punk's Undisputed WWE Championship, Brock Lesnar's retirement announcement following his loss to Oba Femi, and behind-the-scenes content showing The Bloodline's elaborate entrance rehearsals and Cody Rhodes' special helmet entrance gear.

stories.title: TNA Lockdown PPV and Impact Matches
stories.tldr: Elayna Black challenged Knockouts World Champion Xia Brookside for her title at Lockdown on August 23. Additionally, Mustafa Ali made deeply personal threats against Jason Hotch's family during a backstage confrontation, escalating their International Championship cage match at the same event. TNA also announced a partnership with Dude Wipes that will integrate the brand's mascot into storylines.

stories.title: Brock Rechsteiner NFL Suspension
stories.tldr: Brock Rechsteiner, son of WWE Hall of Famer Scott Steiner, has been suspended for six games by the NFL to start the 2026 season. The Jacksonville State product signed with the New Orleans Saints as an undrafted free agent but can still participate in training camp and preseason games. The league has not disclosed the reason for the suspension, though the six-game length has fueled speculation about a potential performance-enhancing drug violation involving test manipulation. A parody account has already turned the situation into wrestling comedy with Scott Steiner memes.

stories.title: Mara Sadé Leaves TNA
stories.tldr: Mara Sadé wrestled her final TNA match on the Aug. 6 Impact taping, losing to Heather by Elegance in the Knockouts Television Championship tournament quarterfinals. The match aired this week as Sadé officially exits as a free agent. AEW and NXT are considered the leading destinations for her next chapter.

stories.title: WWE Returning To Location For First Time In Seven Years For Live Event
stories.tldr: WWE's Hawaii return on October 16 will feature Seth Rollins, The Usos, Jacob Fatu, Oba Femi, Liv Morgan and Sol Ruca. Tickets go on sale August 14, with an exclusive presale starting August 12. WWE will also conduct an NXT tryout at the same venue with details coming soon.

stories.title: Jon Moxley AEW Leadership
stories.tldr: Daniel Garcia credits Jon Moxley with revitalizing AEW after the company lost fan goodwill around 2024 by straying from its alternative identity that made it distinct from WWE. Garcia joined Moxley's Death Riders faction in late 2025 and believes Moxley took decisive action to redirect the company back to its core values, though Garcia declined to fully reveal Moxley's personal motivations for the effort.

stories.title: Adam Copeland AEW Grand Slam Mexico Return
stories.tldr: Adam Copeland is returning to Mexico for the first time in nearly 20 years to compete at Arena Mexico on August 5 during AEW Dynamite: Grand Slam Mexico. Copeland will team with Christian Cage in an eight-man tag team match and expressed his excitement about performing in the historic venue while praising lucha libre's artistry and pageantry.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite Grand Slam Mexico - August 5, 2026
stories.tldr: Hangman Page, Brody King and Bandido won the AEW World Trios Championship in just one week of The Demand's reign, while MJF made a shocking return to attack Andrade El Idolo and announce his entry into the Casino Gauntlet qualifier next week in Las Vegas. Kyle Fletcher retained the International Championship over Mike Bailey in a hard-fought contest, and the Death Riders defeated Cage, Cope and the Young Bucks in an eight-man tag to build momentum heading to All In.

stories.title: AEW All In London 2026 Card Announcements
stories.tldr: Samoa Joe hasn't ruled out returning for All In after being away from AEW TV since May, revealing that Twisted Metal Season 3 filming is nearly complete. The Brawling Birds (Jamie Hayter and Alex Windsor) have officially earned a Women's Tag Team Championship match against Divine Dominion at Wembley after their six-woman tag victory on AEW Grand Slam Mexico.

stories.title: AEW World Trios Championship at Grand Slam Mexico
stories.tldr: "The Good, The Bad, and The Ugly" — featuring Hangman Adam Page, Brody King, and Bandido — won the AEW World Trios Championship at Grand Slam Mexico, defeating The Demand in a hard-fought match that saw the new champions end their opponents' reign after just one week.

stories.title: Kyle Fletcher AEW International Championship Defenses
stories.tldr: Kyle Fletcher retained his AEW International Championship against Mike Bailey at Grand Slam Mexico, winning with a top-rope brainbuster in a hard-fought match. After the bout, Okada appeared and stared down Fletcher and the title before heading to the ring. Bailey has since been working on naming a new move he used in recent matches, considering "Swiss Roll" as a tribute to Claudio Castagnoli.

stories.title: AEW Redemption PPV Montreal
stories.tldr: AEW Redemption's Montreal card produced significant championship changes, with three new titleholders crowned at the Bell Centre. Beyond the buyrate concerns previously reported, the event also established major storyline developments involving Kenny Omega, Will Ospreay, and The Death Riders that appear to set up significant future feuds.

stories.title: WWE/AAA Cross-Promotional Tournament for Roman Reigns Challenger
stories.tldr: WWE announced a historic cross-promotional tournament featuring luchadores from Raw, SmackDown, and AAA, with the winner challenging Roman Reigns for the World Heavyweight Championship on September 14 at Raw in Mexico City. According to Bryan Alvarez, El Grande Americano is the rumored favorite to win the tournament, though nothing is officially locked in and plans could still change.

stories.title: WWE Stars Rebranding After Departures
stories.tldr: Sheamus has rebranded his popular YouTube channel from Celtic Warrior Workouts to S. Farrelly Workouts following his departure from WWE in July 2026 after nearly 20 years. The rebrand reflects his shift to using his real name, Stephen Farrelly, across his professional platforms, and introduces "Brave Change" as both a slogan and the name of a new upcoming series. The channel, which launched in 2017 and became one of wrestling's most successful fitness platforms, featured notable guests including John Cena, Charlotte Flair, and many other WWE and non-wrestling athletes.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown Viewership Numbers
stories.tldr: WWE SmackDown's July 31, 2026 episode drew 1,379,000 viewers and a 0.31 key demo rating, marking an increase week-over-week from July 24's 1,253,000 viewers and 0.23 demo. However, year-over-year comparisons show the show has declined by 10.7% in viewership and 32.6% in the demo rating compared to August 1, 2025. The episode featured top segments including Nick Aldis dropping Gunther and a massive brawl between CM Punk and Cody Rhodes.

stories.title: John Cena Retirement and Post-WWE Activity
stories.tldr: John Cena, who retired from WWE in 2025, continues his post-wrestling career by starring as villain Buddy Crane in the live-action/animated comedy "Coyote vs. Acme," arriving in theaters August 28. Despite appearing exclusively in suits for public appearances, WWE Hall of Famer Kevin Nash revealed that Cena remains his same authentic self behind closed doors, proving that wrestlers never truly stop being workers.

stories.title: WWE Sunday Night's Main Event Preview
stories.tldr: WWE will hold its first Sunday Night's Main Event on September 6 in Atlanta, Georgia, following SummerSlam 2026. The card is predicted to feature major matchups including a six-woman tag team match for the Women's World Championship picture, Big Cass's return match against Je'Von Evans, and title defenses from Baron Corbin, Chad Gable, and Chelsea Green.

stories.title: Triple H WWE Creative Commentary
stories.tldr: Triple H addressed criticism about WWE's main event scene being stagnant, stating that top performers have earned their spots by selling tickets and gaining popularity. He emphasized that talent must get themselves over organically rather than expecting their turn, saying wrestlers should work harder to take the spot themselves rather than waiting for creative to push them.

stories.title: Rey Mysterio and AAA Tournament
stories.tldr: WWE's acquisition of AAA during WrestleMania 41 weekend has led to significant growth for the Mexican promotion, including multiple crossover shows, talent appearances on WWE programming, and merchandise deals. Rey Mysterio, now AAA General Manager, believes the expansion fulfills a vision that Konnan had for the company decades ago when lucha libre was first introduced to Western audiences through WCW in 1996.

stories.title: Ricky Saints WWE Ambitions
stories.tldr: Ricky Saints has outlined his WWE ambitions in a recent interview, naming Brock Lesnar and Seth Rollins as dream opponents while also expressing desires to compete in his hometown Superdome and capture the United States and WWE Championships. Though he fell short in a recent US Championship challenge against Trick Williams, Saints remains focused on achieving his wrestling bucket list goals. Lesnar has since announced his retirement, but Rollins remains a potential future opponent for the SmackDown star.

stories.title: Nikki Bella WWE Plans Following Brie's Injury
stories.tldr: Nikki Bella has decided she does not want to continue her WWE comeback without her sister Brie following Brie's broken shoulder injury at SummerSlam. Nikki made the emotional admission during Brie's vlog while discussing her recovery and potential surgery, stating she would rather wait for Brie to return than pursue another solo run. The decision marks a significant shift from immediate post-SummerSlam focus, which had centered on Brie's toughness in finishing the match to allow Nikki her planned hot tag.

stories.title: WWE NXT News and Roster Changes
stories.tldr: Lola Vice left NXT after losing to Kendal Grey and is expected to join SmackDown to be with boyfriend Damian Priest. Reports suggest multiple potential paths for Vice on the main roster, including challenging for established championships like those held by Raquel Rodriguez, Tiffany Stratton, Liv Morgan, and Chelsea Green. Vice's move to the main roster comes as she continues balancing WWE with her AAA Lucha Libre commitments.

stories.title: Chelsea Green WWE Comments and Reactions
stories.tldr: Chelsea Green has completely reversed her initial frustration with Michael Hayes' criticism, now crediting it as motivation for her SummerSlam title win. She dedicated the championship to Hayes, who found the gesture hilarious and has been a consistent supporter behind the scenes. Green now views his comments as truthful feedback that ultimately helped her career trajectory.

stories.title: Drew McIntyre WWE Return and Acting Career
stories.tldr: Russell Crowe confirmed that filming for The Last Druid has wrapped after shooting in Spain since May, praising McIntyre as a "good lad" and "salt of the earth." With this major project now complete and Highlander in post-production, McIntyre's schedule should open up, though his WWE return remains uncertain despite the possibility becoming more realistic.

stories.title: Joe Gacy WWE Wyatt Sicks Creative Ideas
stories.tldr: The Wyatt Sicks pitched creative ideas weekly during their WWE run, with one major concept being a WandaVision-inspired sitcom featuring the group as a dysfunctional family in a living room setting with eerie, awkward moments and laugh tracks. None of the weekly pitches made it to television, though Gacy noted the group wanted to establish their own identity rather than simply recreate Bray Wyatt's Firefly Fun House.

stories.title: Baron Corbin WWE Return and US Championship
stories.tldr: In his first interview since winning the US Championship at SummerSlam 2026, Corbin opened up about the emotional weight of his comeback match against Trick Williams and credited his independent run for rekindling his hunger and humility. He described feeling intense pressure to deliver on his promise to take the title while managing the overwhelming emotions of stepping back into a WWE arena after 18 months away.

stories.title: Sol Ruca and WWE Women's Intercontinental Championship
stories.tldr: Despite Triple H's public support, a report claims some WWE backstage personnel were unimpressed with Sol Ruca's in-ring performances when they finally saw her on the main roster. Critics argue WWE decision-makers don't watch NXT regularly enough to properly evaluate callup talent, leaving them unprepared to assess Ruca's work before moving her to RAW and SmackDown.

stories.title: WWE Hall of Fame 2027 Location
stories.tldr: Saudi Arabia official Turki Alalshikh publicly dismissed claims that the WWE Hall of Fame would relocate to New York, confirming instead that it will remain in Riyadh as part of WrestleMania 43 weekend. The clarification ended days of confusion sparked by Qatar Pro Wrestling chairman Ali Al-Marafi's report suggesting several WrestleMania week events would be pre-recorded in the United States.

stories.title: Joe Hendry WWE Raw Segment
stories.tldr: Joe Hendry defended the controversial Raw segment on Cheap Heat, explaining that he and everyone involved gave their best effort despite the mixed fan reception. He emphasized his commitment to entertaining audiences and credited WWE fans for elevating his career, while revealing he nearly appeared on Raw in Glasgow before ultimately landing on WrestleMania instead.

stories.title: TNA Impact Wrestling News
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling has scheduled a contract signing between Jeff Hardy and champion Nic Nemeth for the August 6 episode of Impact, with their world title match set for August 13. Meanwhile, independent wrestler Gabby Forza has officially signed with TNA after impressing in her debut matches, including an appearance in the Knockouts Television Championship tournament. Hardy has expressed his determination to prove himself as a singles competitor while competing on the other side of his personal struggles.

stories.title: Candice Michelle In-Ring Return Plans
stories.tldr: Candice Michelle, a former WWE Women's Champion who last competed in 2017, is teasing an in-ring return that she believes is "coming soon." The wrestling veteran has been working as a producer and agent for TNA Wrestling since January, a role she says is helping her prepare for a comeback to active competition with meaningful purpose rather than just chasing another championship.

stories.title: Pete Dunne and AAA Mask Tournament
stories.tldr: Pete Dunne humorously shot down Mason Rook's joke suggestion about entering an upcoming AAA tournament while wearing a luchador mask to hide his identity. Dunne, who works as a backstage producer on WWE's AAA crossover storylines while also performing masked as Rayo Americano on television, quickly dismissed the idea with British wit. The playful exchange highlights the fun side of WWE's growing partnership with AAA and their recent focus on masked wrestler storylines.

stories.title: WWE won’t be baffled by Persephone’s booking at AEW Grand Slam Mexico
stories.tldr: WWE was reportedly baffled by how Tony Khan books CMLL World Women's Champion Persephone to lose frequently on AEW programming despite her world title status. At AEW Grand Slam Mexico, Persephone faced former AEW women's world champion Kris Statlander in a non-title match and won via interference from Hikaru Shida after a ref bump, also setting up a future title program with Thunder Rosa.

stories.title: The Rizzler Can See John Cena
stories.tldr: The Rizzler claimed on social media that he possesses the magical ability to see John Cena, playing off the long-running joke that most people cannot see the WWE star. The post featured a photo of the two together, with Cena currently promoting his upcoming film "Coyote vs. Acme" while The Rizzler was last seen at AEW's Double Or Nothing event in May.

stories.title: 2027 WWE Royal Rumble Winner
stories.tldr: WWE has announced that the 2027 Royal Rumble will take place in Glendale, Arizona in February, and speculation has begun about potential winners. The article highlights ten potential candidates for both the Men's and Women's Royal Rumble matches, including current champions, rising stars, and veterans seeking to add the accomplishment to their legacies. Notable candidates include Sami Zayn, who could regain championship gold at WrestleMania 43 in Saudi Arabia, and CM Punk, who still needs the Royal Rumble victory to complete his career accomplishments.

stories.title: Bad Ass Construction Worker Claims He Could Run NXT Better Than Shawn Michaels
stories.tldr: A construction worker has continued his public feud with NXT General Manager Shawn Michaels, claiming the brand has become unwatchable following recent main roster call-ups. He has volunteered himself to run NXT, insisting he could do a better job than Michaels and that almost nobody on the current roster is worth watching, with only Grayson Waller receiving any form of praise.

stories.title: Former WWE Stars Released and Indies
stories.tldr: Kairi Sane elaborated on her WWE release in a new interview, revealing that the unfinished storyline with Asuka was so significant she might have retired had it concluded properly, though she's now focused on evaluating numerous international offers. Meanwhile, Uhaa Nation (Apollo Crews) announced his return to Dragon Gate for September 12, marking his first appearance for the promotion since 2015, while Gzim Selmani from Authors of Pain discussed the backstage incident that led to AOP's release and his current pursuit of bare-knuckle boxing.

stories.title: Adam Copeland is a big loser in his Arena Mexico debut
stories.tldr: Adam Copeland made his Arena Mexico debut on Dynamite: Grand Slam Mexico, receiving a warm reception from fans. However, his tag team with Christian Cage and the Young Bucks suffered an upset loss to Jon Moxley's Death Riders when a late miscommunication allowed Mox to pin Copeland for the victory.

stories.title: MJF Violent Night 2 movie appearance
stories.tldr: AEW star MJF has been featured in the official trailer for Universal Pictures' Violent Night 2, which releases December 4. In the action-comedy sequel, MJF plays one of the main antagonists causing chaos for David Harbour's reimagined Santa Claus character. This marks another addition to MJF's growing Hollywood resume, following previous appearances in The Iron Claw and Happy Gilmore 2.

stories.title: Chris Jericho AEW philosophy
stories.tldr: Chris Jericho stated that AEW has never focused on competing with WWE, instead maintaining its own identity and product quality since its inception. He credited the company's momentum to internal factors like roster strength and leadership rather than WWE's corporate direction. When considering his options in early 2026, Jericho ultimately chose to stay with AEW because he helped found the company, making it uniquely meaningful to his legacy.

stories.title: AEW Grand Slam Mexico 2026
stories.tldr: AEW Grand Slam Mexico 2026 takes place this week from Arena Mexico in partnership with CMLL, with the broadcast starting at 8pm ET/7pm CT/5pm PT on Wednesday. The event will air on TBS and HBO Max in the US, with various broadcast options available globally including MyAEW for international viewers and free replay options in select markets.

stories.title: Tony Schiavone ALS Ice Bucket Challenge
stories.tldr: Legendary wrestling commentator Tony Schiavone participated in the ALS Ice Bucket Challenge on August 4 to show support for Rebel, who is battling ALS. After being nominated by Renee Paquette and having ice water dumped on him by his grandchildren, Schiavone nominated Justin Roberts, Nigel McGuinness, Blake Christian, and Lee Johnson to participate next. The wrestling community continues rallying behind Rebel, with AEW planning a special "AEW Rebel Heart" event on September 9.

stories.title: Liv Morgan and MJF movie trailers
stories.tldr: WWE's Liv Morgan and AEW's MJF both released movie trailers within 24 hours of each other. Morgan appears in Bad Lieutenant: Tokyo directed by Takashi Miike, where she's billed under her WWE name and appears to have a substantial role involving action scenes. MJF has a part in the upcoming Violent Night 2, scheduled for December 4, 2026, where he appears as one of the antagonists' henchmen.

stories.title: Speedball Mike Bailey on AEW International Champion
stories.tldr: "Speedball" Mike Bailey believes Don Callis is holding back AEW International Champion Kyle Fletcher ahead of their Grand Slam Mexico matchup. Bailey, who earned his title shot by winning a six-man Ladder Match at AEW Redemption, wants a clean victory over Fletcher free from outside interference. Bailey has previously criticized the Don Callis Family as operating like a pyramid scheme with over 10 members.

stories.title: AEW All Out 2026 ticket sales
stories.tldr: AEW All Out 2026 is scheduled for September 26 at the NOW Arena in Hoffman Estates, Illinois, with 5,928 tickets distributed so far. The event represents a return to Chicago tradition but moves away from the Labor Day weekend slot due to scheduling constraints with All In in London. Tony Khan explained the decision allows for proper four-week build time between the two major pay-per-views.

stories.title: Mara Sade TNA to AEW transition
stories.tldr: Multiple sources now confirm AEW is the expected destination for Mara Sade, with both locker room and management-level expectations pointing to a signing. TNA reportedly increased their offer to retain her, but sources within AEW have been proactively working to bring her in. Sade will be reunited with her significant other, Kevin Knight, who currently holds the AEW TNT Championship and recently main-evented an AEW PPV.

stories.title: Jay White AEW injury update
stories.tldr: Jay White suffered a head injury during a double chain match at AEW Redemption when David Finlay spiked him with a Dominator-style move. However, the injury is considered minor, with White expected to miss only about a week of action. He has been cleared to compete in the inaugural AEW Continental Cup tournament, facing David Finlay in the first round on August 12.

stories.title: Motor City Machine Guns WWE to AEW
stories.tldr: Following the Motor City Machine Guns' AEW debut, speculation is mounting that other recent WWE releases could join them, including members of The New Day, The Wyatt Sicks, and several performers who departed during April 2026's mass cuts. Names being discussed include Kofi Kingston, Xavier Woods, Zoey Stark, Joe Gacy, Alba Fyre, Santos Escobar, and Sheamus, all of whom have either been released or left WWE and could significantly impact AEW's roster depth.

stories.title: Bianca Belair and Montez Ford welcome baby
stories.tldr: WWE stars Bianca Belair and Montez Ford announced on August 4 that they have welcomed their first child together, a baby boy named Romeo Leonardo Allen Crawford. Belair revealed her pregnancy at WrestleMania 42 in April after keeping it private for months, with the announcement idea pitched by Triple H to allow her to remain part of the event despite being unable to compete. The couple has been married since 2018 and has chronicled their personal journey on the reality series "Love & WWE: Bianca & Montez."

stories.title: Lola Vice WWE NXT departure
stories.tldr: Lola Vice's WWE NXT tenure came to an end on August 4, 2026, when she lost her undefeated NXT Underground match streak to Kendal Grey in a brutal championship bout. After the match, Vice said an emotional goodbye to the NXT fanbase at the WWE Performance Center, with her boyfriend Damian Priest making a surprise appearance to embrace her as she left her gloves in the ring. Vice is expected to join the WWE SmackDown roster as a main roster call-up.

stories.title: WWE NXT card and booking
stories.tldr: WWE NXT has stacked next week's August 11 card with major matchups including a Number One Contender's match between Cruz Montana and Grayson Waller for a shot at Tony D'Angelo's NXT Championship at Heatwave on August 30, plus ZARIA defending the NXT Women's North American Championship against Wren Sinclair. The show also features a mixed tag team match with The Culling taking on Shawn Spears and Lizzy Rain, and a singles bout between Dion Lennox and Saquon Shugars as NXT builds toward its major pay-per-view event.

stories.title: Myles Borne NXT Tag Team Championship
stories.tldr: Myles Borne and Tavion Heights defeated The Vanity Project on the August 4 episode of WWE NXT to capture the NXT Tag Team Championship. With this victory, Borne became a double champion by adding the tag titles to his NXT North American Championship, joining Adam Cole as only the second wrestler to hold both titles simultaneously. The win marked Heights' first championship victory in WWE and reignited their partnership from their former No Quarter Catch Crew days.

stories.title: WWE executives and departures
stories.tldr: Patrick Dooley, WWE's Senior Vice President of Global Strategy & Corporate Development, quietly departed the company in late July as part of broader budget cut layoffs. Widely regarded as Paul "Triple H" Levesque's second-in-command on the business side, Dooley had been instrumental in major WWE initiatives since joining in 2018, including the acquisition of Lucha Libre AAA and securing its television deal with FOX Latin America.

stories.title: WWE Royal Rumble 2027 Arizona announcement
stories.tldr: TKO Group Holdings announced that WWE Royal Rumble 2027 will be held at State Farm Stadium in Glendale, Arizona in February 2027, marking the third time the event comes to Arizona. The announcement is part of a groundbreaking multi-year partnership between TKO and the Arizona Sports & Events Alliance that will bring seven major events from WWE, UFC, PBR, and Zuffa Boxing to the state over three years, with several confirmed dates already set.

stories.title: Shiloh Hill injury update
stories.tldr: WWE NXT prospect Shiloh Hill confirmed he suffered a fractured maxilla (upper jawbone) during his match against Tristan Angels on July 28 and announced he will be sidelined for the foreseeable future. Hill revealed the injury in a pre-recorded video during the August 4 episode of NXT, explaining that adrenaline initially masked the severity of the fracture. While no official return timeline has been announced, Hill maintained his personality while addressing fans and acknowledged that surgery and recovery will keep him away from in-ring competition for a while.

stories.title: WWE Raw and Netflix viewership
stories.tldr: WWE Raw on Netflix maintained consistent viewership of 2.4 million global views for the third consecutive week with the July 27 episode, which served as the go-home show for SummeSlam featuring Roman Reigns vs. Seth Rollins and an Oba Femi/Brock Lesnar weigh-in. Global hours viewed increased to 4.8 million, up 700,000 from the prior week and in line with the rolling 10-week average. The episode ranked seventh globally in views and was a top ten show in seven countries including fifth in the U.S.

stories.title: Nick Aldis WWE debut and TNA career
stories.tldr: Nick Aldis made his long-awaited WWE in-ring debut at SummerSlam against Gunther, with his wife Mickie James and son Donovan watching ringside in an emotional family moment. After the match, Aldis resigned from his in-ring role but was reinstated as SmackDown General Manager. Aldis has also reflected on how poor booking of his final TNA match against AJ Styles in 2013 negatively impacted his career trajectory.

stories.title: Damian Priest Marvel role
stories.tldr: WWE Superstar Damian Priest has joined the Marvel Universe by voicing Parker Robbins, also known as The Hood, in the video game Marvel Rivals. The character will debut as a Vanguard in Season 9.5: The Mystery of Thebes, launching August 7, 2026, expanding Priest's entertainment portfolio beyond his in-ring WWE career.

stories.title: Drew McIntyre gym with Russell Crowe
stories.tldr: Drew McIntyre shared a gym photo with Russell Crowe on August 4 while filming The Last Druid, captioning it "Gladiator x Warrior" to reference both actors' iconic roles. The former WWE Champion remains away from WWE television as he continues his acting projects in Hollywood, including work on the film and a reported involvement with Amazon MGM's Highlander reboot.

stories.title: The Undertaker retirement and podcast
stories.tldr: The Undertaker has revealed that retirement life has been far busier than expected, filled with podcast work, AAA creative responsibilities, and various appearances rather than the hunting and outdoor activities he originally envisioned. Most significantly, he stated he has no interest in continuing his Six Feet Under podcast and plans to end it within months once his current contract expires, admitting he would "rather go to the dentist and pull a tooth" than do a podcast.

stories.title: WWE NXT SummerSlam tryout promo advice
stories.tldr: At WWE's SummerSlam week tryout in Minneapolis, NXT head writer Johnny Russo offered aspiring wrestlers specific guidance on cutting promos, emphasizing the importance of sounding natural and authentic. Russo stressed that talent should avoid common mistakes like speaking in robotic phrases, asking unanswered rhetorical questions, using generic lines, and making distracting body movements that take focus away from their message.

stories.title: Je'Von Evans mentored by Becky Lynch
stories.tldr: WWE rising star Je'Von Evans, just 22 years old, recently revealed that former WWE Women's Champion Becky Lynch serves as his mentor. Evans praised Lynch for providing honest feedback on his performances and being available whenever he needs guidance or advice. The young wrestler has already established himself as a talented and popular performer on WWE's main roster.

stories.title: Danhausen WWE debut reception
stories.tldr: Kit Wilson revealed that some WWE wrestlers backstage were initially unhappy with Danhausen's surprise debut at Elimination Chamber 2026, feeling he took a valuable pay-per-view spot from other performers. Despite the mixed initial reception and some audible boos from the crowd, Danhausen quickly became one of the most popular and merchandise-successful Superstars on the roster, eventually winning at SummerSlam. Wilson credited himself with putting Danhausen on the map after facing him in his debut match.

stories.title: Baron Corbin WWE exit and success
stories.tldr: Baron Corbin, who was released from WWE in November 2024 after over a decade with the company, has returned to WWE as the new United States Champion following his victory over Trick Williams at SummerSlam 2026. During his year-and-a-half absence on the independent circuit as Bishop Dyer, Corbin credits his time away with helping him grow exponentially, teaching him humility, and reminding him of his passion for wrestling without the safety net of WWE's infrastructure.

stories.title: Bryan and Vinny Show episode
stories.tldr: Bryan and Vinny return with their latest episode featuring a discussion of In Your House 6 from Netflix, highlighting an excellent Owen Hart vs. Shawn Michaels match. The show includes their regular segments with Granny, listener questions, wrestling and soap opera reports, and weekly trivia.

stories.title: Tiffany Stratton fashion inspiration
stories.tldr: Women's United States Champion Tiffany Stratton revealed her fashion inspiration sources on WWE Break It Down, citing music artists, Pinterest, and iconic pop culture characters like Paris Hilton, Sharpay Evans from High School Musical, and Cher Horowitz from Clueless. Her gear choices reflect her character's bright, vibrant Barbie-esque aesthetic, with recent outfits paying homage to Megan Thee Stallion and the Minnesota Vikings.

stories.title: Wren Sinclair Women's NA Title
stories.tldr: Wren Sinclair retained her WWE NXT Women's Speed Championship against Zaria in a five-minute time limit draw, earning herself a future shot at Zaria's Women's North American Championship. The match was competitive throughout, with both competitors trading offense until time expired with Sinclair countering Zaria's F5 attempt as the clock hit zero. A frustrated Zaria then attacked Sinclair after the match, hitting the F5 on the champion.

stories.title: WWE AAA Worlds Collide Chicago matches
stories.tldr: WWE and Lucha Libre AAA are planning a major Worlds Collide event in Chicago on September 26, 2026, directly competing against AEW's All Out pay-per-view on the same day. The article proposes six potential matches including CM Punk defending the Undisputed WWE Championship against Dominik Mysterio, a three-way tag team championship match, and a 12-woman tag team bout featuring top stars from both promotions.

stories.title: LA Knight WWE Raw momentum
stories.tldr: Bully Ray praised LA Knight's performance on Monday Night Raw as the best of his WWE career, highlighting his improved timing, swagger, and confidence during a verbal confrontation with Roman Reigns. Knight challenged the WWE World Heavyweight Champion after his SummerSlam victory over The Bloodline members, with the potential title match possibly coming at Sunday Night's Main Event on September 6.

stories.title: WWE SummerSlam 2026 tryouts MVP
stories.tldr: Tayleigh Robertson has been named the MVP of WWE's SummerSlam 2026 tryouts held in Minneapolis, Minnesota. This marks the second year WWE has awarded an MVP title at their annual tryout event, with Robertson following in the footsteps of last year's winner Rayne Leverkusen, who is now competing on NXT as Lizzy Rain. The tryouts are expected to bring several new talents to the NXT roster as part of the brand's ongoing rebuilding phase.

stories.title: WWE Hall of Fame 2027 Saudi Arabia
stories.tldr: The WWE Hall of Fame 2027 will remain in Saudi Arabia as part of WrestleMania 43 weekend, according to confirmation from Saudi Arabia official Turki Alalshikh. A recent report had claimed the Hall of Fame would move to New York, but Alalshikh quickly shut down the rumor via Twitter, clarifying that all events including the Hall of Fame will take place in Riyadh.

stories.title: Kevin Owens WWE return plans
stories.tldr: Kevin Owens returned to WWE at SummerSlam after undergoing neck surgery in July 2024, making his comeback exactly one year post-surgery. Originally hoping to return in time to face John Cena during his Retirement Tour, Owens' medical team repeatedly denied clearance until early July 2025, when scans finally showed sufficient bone growth and recovery progress to allow his in-ring return.

stories.title: Michael Cole WWE career expectations
stories.tldr: Michael Cole recently revealed he initially expected his WWE career to last only one year before returning to broadcast journalism. What started as a temporary opportunity to gain television experience evolved into nearly three decades with the company. Cole credited WWE's predictable travel schedule with providing his family the stability that his previous news position at WCBS could not offer.

stories.title: WWE NXT August 4 start time
stories.tldr: WWE NXT airs tonight, August 4, 2026, on the CW at 8pm ET/7pm CT/5pm PT from the WWE Performance Center in Orlando. The show features several championship matches including Kendal Grey defending the NXT Women's Championship against Lola Vice in an NXT Underground match, Brad Baylor and Ricky Smokes challenging for the NXT Tag Team Championship, and Wren Sinclair competing for the WWE Speed title against NXT Women's North American Champion Zaria.

stories.title: The Undertaker career killer Gunther
stories.tldr: The Undertaker revealed in a recent podcast interview that Gunther would have been a likely candidate to retire him had his wrestling career extended into 2026. The WWE Hall of Famer praised Gunther's in-ring work and storytelling ability while also highlighting emerging talents like Oba Femi and Trick Williams as top names he would have enjoyed facing before retirement.

stories.title: Brock Lesnar SummerSlam and retirement
stories.tldr: Brock Lesnar officially confirmed his retirement on The Pat McAfee Show, ending months of speculation. The decision came after his emotional SummerSlam loss to Oba Femi in Minneapolis, though he admitted he'd initially considered retiring after losing to Femi at WrestleMania 42. Lesnar now plans to focus on hunting and supporting his children's athletic pursuits.

stories.title: The Undertaker interview and current WWE stars
stories.tldr: The Undertaker named three current WWE stars he would have loved to work with—Gunther, Oba Femi, and Trick Williams—while also revealing that Vince McMahon blocked his dream match against Sting. He's also weighing in on his daughter Kaia's wrestling ambitions and urging today's performers to prioritize storytelling over dangerous high-flying spots.

stories.title: Stephanie Vaquer return and WWE rumors
stories.tldr: Stephanie Vaquer returned to WWE on Raw after being medically cleared for weeks, but the company deliberately withheld her comeback to avoid "wasting" her return. WWE finalized her return just days before Raw, booked her travel late to prevent fan sightings, and kept her hidden backstage until her surprise entrance alongside Becky Lynch's return.

stories.title: The Bloodline storyline after SummerSlam
stories.tldr: Jacob Fatu brutalized Royce Keys on Raw, prompting speculation about The Bloodline's next targets, while Eric Bischoff warned WWE risks repeating the nWo's fatal expansion mistake. Meanwhile, Rey Mysterio's pitch of a Roman Reigns AAA appearance has fueled debate about when and where The Tribal Chief might debut in Mexico's top promotion.

stories.title: Ryan Garcia WWE Raw segment
stories.tldr: Following intense backlash to his Raw appearance, Ryan Garcia blamed WWE creative for the poor reception of his segment. Garcia stated he wished he had been given a better role, comparing his vision to past Floyd Mayweather appearances, and expressed frustration that the weak booking contributed to the hate he received online.

stories.title: Grayson Waller NXT title picture
stories.tldr: Tony D'Angelo responded to Waller's challenge with a heated segment on NXT, dismissing him as irrelevant and mocking his return strategy. The confrontation evolved when Cruz Montana also demanded a title shot, leading D'Angelo to book a No. 1 contender's match between Waller and Montana for next week, with the winner facing him at Heatwave.

stories.title: Dragon Lee injury update
stories.tldr: Dragon Lee is hoping to avoid surgery on his torn thumb ligament and instead continue wrestling while managing the injury, according to recent comments on Notsam Wrestling Live. The WWE star is willing to compete while the injury heals rather than face a three to four month recovery period that surgery would require. WWE medical staff has indicated he may be able to wrestle through the injury.

stories.title: Roman Reigns AAA appearance setup
stories.tldr: Dave Meltzer has narrowed down where Roman Reigns will appear for AAA, ruling out the August 30 Texas show and the September 11 Las Vegas TripleMania event. The most likely destination is now AAA Worlds Collide in Chicago on September 26, which would put Reigns head-to-head with AEW All Out in the same city, though Meltzer stressed he cannot confirm Roman's involvement.

stories.title: Chelsea Green Interim WWE Women's Championship
stories.tldr: Chelsea Green won the interim WWE Women's Championship at SummerSlam by climbing the ladder after being left hanging by B-Fab and Michin. Green posted an emotional video message crediting 13 years of work for the moment and joking about "world domination" beginning with her title reign. She could face current champion Rhea Ripley when Ripley returns, or defend against other ladder match competitors first.

stories.title: Big Cass WWE return
stories.tldr: Big Cass made his shocking WWE return on August 3, 2026 RAW after an eight-year absence, attacking Je'Von Evans with the East River Crossing. Backstage reports reveal he was in excellent spirits and soaking in every moment of his long-awaited comeback, making it clear his goal is to rebuild his reputation by "stacking bodies" on the roster.

stories.title: Joseph Sawyer Joe Gacy WWE release
stories.tldr: Sawyer revealed that Shawn Michaels pitched him a Scientology-inspired cult character that initially drew controversy, leading to his temporary removal from TV before Vince McMahon reversed the decision. He also turned down Michaels' suggestion to perform breakdancing on television despite mentioning the skill during an in-house Performance Center talent show.

stories.title: The Undertaker daughter Kaia wrestling aspirations
stories.tldr: The Undertaker opened up about his mixed feelings regarding his daughter Kaia's wrestling aspirations, expressing concerns about the physical toll of the profession while remaining supportive of her pursuing her passion. Despite his reservations about the grind and daily pain that comes with a wrestling career, he committed to helping her succeed if she chooses that path. Kaia has already been training and impressing with her in-ring skills, even putting creative twists on her father's signature moves.

stories.title: Dory Funk Jr. passes away
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Dory Funk Jr., one of professional wrestling's greatest technical wrestlers and influential trainers, passed away on August 4, 2026, at age 85. The legendary former NWA World Heavyweight Champion, who held the title for over four years from 1969 to 1973, had a career spanning more than six decades and trained countless future stars through his Funking Conservatory in Ocala, Florida, where he lived with his wife Marti.

stories.title: Joey Janela PRODUCE Wrestling departure
stories.tldr: Joey Janela has ended his working relationship with PRODUCE Wrestling after a heated dispute with promoter Adam Abdalla over a canceled flight and travel arrangements. Janela pulled out of curating the September 13 Jersey City event with Megan Bayne, claiming Abdalla has become "absolutely unhinged, deplorable and embarrassing" over the past year or two, with multiple wrestlers reportedly expressing concerns about his behavior toward talent.

stories.title: Kairi Sane WWE release and offers
stories.tldr: Kairi Sane was blindsided by her WWE release just as her character was poised for a major storyline payoff on RAW. Since becoming a free agent, she has received numerous offers from promotions worldwide and is carefully evaluating her options while taking time to decide her next destination. The #WeWantKairi fan movement that trended globally after her release provided emotional support and reinforced her determination to continue her wrestling career.

stories.title: Mick Foley ALS Ice Bucket Challenge
stories.tldr: Mick Foley participated in the ALS Ice Bucket Challenge to support his friend Rebel, who is battling ALS, and nominated Kevin Owens, Kevin Nash, and The Rock to continue the challenge. Foley used the moment to emphasize that the cause is bigger than wrestling rivalries and called for the community to unite behind Rebel and ALS awareness efforts.

stories.title: MLW 2300 Arena contract dispute
stories.tldr: MLW announced on August 4 that its October 3 television taping has been relocated from Philadelphia's 2300 Arena to Center Stage in Atlanta due to the venue breaching its contractual agreement with the promotion. MLW stated it explored options to find another Philadelphia-area venue but the late timing made it impossible, and the promotion says it will not return to 2300 Arena in the future.

stories.title: NJPW TAMASHII Openweight Championship announcement
stories.tldr: New Japan Pro-Wrestling has announced the creation of the NJPW TAMASHII Openweight Championship, the promotion's first singles title for their Oceania-based brand. Wrestlers will compete at Road to First Reign on August 29, 2026, in Auckland to earn a title shot at the inaugural championship match set for October 4. The openweight format will allow competitors of all weights to challenge for TAMASHII's premier singles prize.

stories.title: Paramount Warner Bros Discovery merger trial
stories.tldr: A federal judge has set March 2-19, 2027, as the trial date for the antitrust case challenging the proposed Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery merger. The timeline aligns more closely with requests from state attorneys general and the Writers Guild of America rather than Paramount's preferred November 2026 date. The merger agreement expires June 4, 2027, with a $7 billion termination fee at stake if regulatory issues block the deal.

stories.title: Wrestling Observer Radio updates
stories.tldr: WWE faces a significant shareholder lawsuit payout while Roman Reigns' involvement with AAA is being hinted at by the company. The episode covers WWE Raw's post-SummerSlam programming, CMLL and AEW's Mexico events, and updates from TKO's conference call including news about BJ Penn and a Cain Velasquez documentary.

stories.title: WCW Nitro Lex Luger WCW Championship
stories.tldr: On August 4, 1997, Lex Luger defeated Hulk Hogan to win the WCW World Heavyweight Championship on the 99th episode of WCW Nitro in Auburn Hills, Michigan. Though the title match itself received only a 3/4-star rating, the overall show quality was significantly stronger than WWF Raw that week, with viewers staying engaged throughout the three-hour broadcast that featured strong undercard matches and effective storytelling around the main event.

stories.title: Wrestling title changes August 4
stories.tldr: August 4 has historically been a significant date for professional wrestling title changes, with approximately 227 major title changes occurring on this date throughout history. Notable champions crowned on this day include Lex Luger winning the WCW World Heavyweight Title in 1997, Batista and John Cena capturing the WWE World Tag Team Titles in 2008, and Tatsumi Fujinami winning the WWF International Heavyweight Title in 1983. The date has seen championship victories across multiple wrestling promotions spanning from 1967 to 2020.

stories.title: Grayson Waller, Cruz Montana Both Eye Tony D’Angelo’s Title as Fans Pick Sides
stories.tldr: Tony D'Angelo addressed two major threats to his NXT Championship on the August 4 episode when both Grayson Waller and Cruz Montana demanded title opportunities. Rather than choose between them, D'Angelo booked a No. 1 contender's match between Waller and Montana at NXT Heatwave, though many fans have called for a Triple Threat Match instead.

stories.title: Blake Monroe Compares WWE Main Roster to NXT: ‘More Free Rein’
stories.tldr: Blake Monroe has praised her transition from NXT to WWE's main roster, citing significantly more creative freedom and independence as the key difference. Unlike NXT's hands-on developmental approach for recruits with little wrestling experience, the main roster expects talent to operate autonomously both in and out of the ring. Monroe's larger-than-life personality appears well-suited to this freedom, and she's currently targeting championship opportunities while maintaining her glamorous mystique.

stories.title: Theory On Missing WWE SummerSlam Attendance Announcement
stories.tldr: WWE did not announce official attendance figures for either night of SummerSlam 2026 at U.S. Bank Stadium, a notably rare occurrence for a major WWE stadium event. Dave Meltzer believes this silence indicates WWE's dissatisfaction with the approximately 69,000 combined tickets distributed, especially given that AEW's All In: London is tracking toward surpassing those numbers. The decision stands out because WWE typically publicizes attendance for shows drawing over 11,000 people, making the absence of numbers for one of WWE's flagship events particularly telling.

stories.title: Location and venue for the 2027 WWE Royal Rumble PLE officially announecd
stories.tldr: TKO Group Holdings announced a multi-year partnership with Arizona to bring major live events to the state, with WWE's 2027 Royal Rumble confirmed to take place in Glendale at either Desert Diamond Arena or State Farm Stadium. The seven-event agreement spanning three years marks TKO's first-ever state-level partnership encompassing WWE, UFC, PBR, and Zuffa Boxing. The announcement highlights Arizona's commitment to hosting world-class sporting events and driving economic growth through tourism and business investment.

stories.title: Jacob Fatu suggests online critics step into a ring “to see if they could take a punch to the face from us”
stories.tldr: WWE star Jacob Fatu responded to criticism from online wrestling fans during a podcast appearance, challenging detractors to step into the ring and experience the physical demands of professional wrestling. Fatu suggested critics don't even deserve to take a bump, only to see if they could withstand a punch to the face, and advised people to stay off the internet rather than sharing their opinions online.

stories.title: Top WWE Star Spotted At Performance Center, Hall Of Famer Also Expected To Appear
stories.tldr: CM Punk was spotted at the WWE Performance Center on August 4, with the specific purpose of his visit unclear. Additionally, WWE Hall of Famer Sean Waltman (X-Pac) is expected to make an appearance at the facility later in August. Both wrestlers were present at SummerSlam, with Punk successfully defending his Undisputed WWE Championship against Cody Rhodes.

stories.title: The Undertaker AAA creative role
stories.tldr: The Undertaker has elaborated further on his creative vision for AAA, revealing he collaborated with Jeremy Borash on the El Grande Americano match concept and shared details about creating his signature "Old School" move and preferences on taking the chokeslam.

stories.title: Jeff Cobb PRODUCE Wrestling appearance
stories.tldr: Jeff Cobb's 90-day WWE non-compete has now expired, allowing him to appear on indie promotions streaming through MyAEW.
